Trustworthy only up to: SIP enabled, a NON-ROOT attacker (root can disable SIP / bypass AMFI), and this binary's signing strength — signing_authority=unknown_local_or_ad_hoc, ad-hoc signed (no Developer-ID / notarization / library validation). Does NOT prove hardware-rooted measurement: no TEE and no hardware register are involved, so this is NOT tee_measured. A root attacker with SIP disabled is the named residual, closed only by tee_measured (out of scope here).
